Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — scheduling rotating deep-dive slots for Medify Health

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand Medify's latency targets and the multi-region compliance constraints. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can lock in the technical deep dive: 

- Recap: primary goals are predictable sub-150ms token latency for core inference, secure audit logging retention for 12 months, and an isolated deployment per tenant for PHI workflows.
- Ask: we should run a 90-minute technical deep dive with infra + security engineers (Redwood and Medify) to align on network paths, KV-cache expectations, and rollout strategy.

To make scheduling straightforward across your US/EU/APAC teams, I put together three rotating slot patterns (all 90-min windows). Please indicate which option works best for you, or propose 1–2 alternatives: 

Option A (US-first week): 08:00 PT / 17:00 CET / 00:00 SGT (next day)
Option B (EU-balanced week): 11:00 PT / 20:00 CET / 03:00 SGT (next day)
Option C (APAC-first week): 16:00 PT / 01:00 CET (next day) / 08:00 SGT

Our suggestion is a 3-week rotating cadence: week 1 choose a US-friendly slot, week 2 an EU-friendly slot, week 3 an APAC-friendly slot — then repeat. That minimizes late/night repeats for any one party while keeping momentum.

I've attached the post-call notes (discovery-notes.pdf) and a draft agenda for the deep dive (tech-deep-dive-agenda.md). If Option B looks OK, I can send a calendar invite that rotates every third meeting to cover all regions.

Next steps suggested:
- Sara/Tom: confirm preferred option (A/B/C) and any hard no-go times
- Jordan: draft rotating cadence calendar and invite (upon confirmation)
- Karthik/Laura: confirm which internal engineers will join (infra + security)

Thanks — I can be flexible next week for a quick 10-min sync to finalize times if that helps.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jordan — helpful summary. We like the rotating cadence idea. A couple of constraints on our side to call out:

- Our infra lead (Tom) is in CET and prefers no recurring meetings later than 21:00 CET on weekdays.
- Our APAC product team prefers early-morning Singapore windows rather than late-night.

Of your three options, Option B is closest to what we can support if the pattern rotates (EU week centered). Practically, here are three concrete slots that map to Option B and are easier for our team calendar: 

1) Tue 11 Nov, 11:00 PT / 20:00 CET / Wed 03:00 SGT (we can rotate that SGT burden away next cycle)
2) Wed 12 Nov, 11:00 PT / 20:00 CET / Thu 03:00 SGT
3) Thu 13 Nov, 11:00 PT / 20:00 CET / Fri 03:00 SGT

If you can rotate the next two meetings to be more APAC-friendly (e.g., an APAC-morning slot in the following rotation), we're happy to confirm one of these this week.

Also: can you include an agenda item for network egress patterns and our Egress IP allowlist? That's a hard requirement for our security review.

Sara Lin
Head of Platform Partnerships
Medify Health
